dilemma: Billionaire: I thought my mind was playing a trick with me, Mr. {playerName}, what are you doing here.
{playerName}: Oh just making my way around the city making some connections before the election, you know, helping the people i serve.
Bilionaire: Well am i glad you said that. You see, I'm in a bit of a pickle. I've been planning to build a small get-away cabin in the woods like a vacation house, but close to home.
{playerName}: Sounds amazing, it would certainly increase the interest newcomers would have in the city.

Bilionaire: Well, there is just one small problem. I want to build it in the forest but someone a long time ago decided it was a protected property forest so i can't build it there. Let's just say that if the forest is no longer protected, you might find a cabin with your name on the mailbox.
Lawyer: Welcome Mr. {playerName} what brings you to my humble offices
{playerName}: Oh i wouldn't say humble, your place is massive, with beautiful offices, do you rent them out, I've been looking around.
Lawyer: Well we want to, you know to give something more to the city, but we run into a problem. You see prosecuting everyone for everything takes a lot of associates and space.

{playerName}: But if we could get our hands on the bottom floor from the people at rødekors we could expand. You know, I have some leverage over some of them and with a little help from you we could kick them out and find a nice office for you.
Bank manager: Well hello there {playerName}, I have a proposal for you. Theoretically, what would you say if I could give you access to a secret account with 500.000 DKK as a campaign contribution.
{playerName}: Well, no one would give the new town politician that amount of money, so I sound like you want something in return.

Bank Manager: You are a smart man, I like that. I know after this election the city is going to make some large investments that requires some loans. All I ask for you is to consider my bank as the bank to loan that money from, even though we might not have the best terms regarding the citizens of the city.
Festival organizer: Oh Mr. {playerName}, am I glad to see you.
{playerName}: Always a pleasure, I was just in the neighborhood and thought i would swing by to see how the progress is going with the festival.
Festival organizer: Well {playerName}, we are trying to get accessibility ramps throughout the festival, but it will put us over the budget.
{playerName}: Oh I am so sorry to hear, is there anything I could do.

Festival organizer: Well the cityhall had always donated to the festival, but this year the money is going to a lunch for you and the other politicians. If maybe you could find it in your heart to get the donation back, then we could arrange a beautiful lunch here, in the heart of the city and community
Staff: Oh, hello {playerName}. We didn't expect you to drop by the shelter today. What brings you here?
{playerName}: Just walking around the city and looking for people who needs some help.
Staff: To be honest, we just received a big donation of warm winter clothes, but we lack hands to sort them out to the residents. Would you be willing to help us with that?
Club Volunteer: Hey, we're short on volunteers for Saturday's youth tournament. Could you give us a hand?
{playerName}: I've got other things to do. What's in it for me?
Club Volunteer: Not much, honestly. The club runs on volunteers. The more people help out, the more activities we can offer the kids.
{playerName}: So I'd just be helping the community?
Club Volunteer: Exactly. A few hours of your time means dozens of children get a great day of sports.
Club Volunteer: Can you help us, and volunteer at the tournament?
Company Manager: Hey, I need a favor. We're bidding on a municipal contract, and a good word from someone in the city would really help.
{playerName}: You mean put in a recommendation?
Company Manager: Nothing official. Just let people know we're the "right choice." If we get the contract, there could be something in it for you.
{playerName}: So you want me to influence the decision?
Company Manager: Let's just say we'd both benefit. The process is slow enough already.
Company Manager: Could you help the company secure the contract through your personal connections?
Farm Owner: Hello! I need your help! Could you assist me with reducing the cost of producing my goods?
{playerName}: How would I do that?
Farm Owner: You could reduce some legislation on farming. Then I could use more pesticides in my produce!
{playerName}: But aren't you the supplier for the local school?
Farm Owner:  Yes, but I NEED the money! Please! I will make a personal delivery every week with free items from my farm...
Farm Owner: Will you use your influence, and reduce legislation to help me?
Construction Foreman: Glad you're here. We're expecting a safety inspection tomorrow, and there are a few issues that still need fixing.
{playerName}: If they're not fixed, won't that be a problem?
Construction Foreman: Maybe. But delays cost money. If the inspector doesn't look too closely, the project stays on schedule.
{playerName}: And what do you want from me?
Construction Foreman: Put in a good word. Convince them there's no need for a thorough inspection. You may even get a penthouse apartment. Who knows?
{playerName}: Even if the site isn't fully compliant?
Construction Foreman: It'll be fixed eventually. Why hold up the whole project over a few minor details?
Construction Foreman: Could you use your influence to reduce the scrutiny of the forthcoming inspection?
Staff: Hello {playerName}, what a surprise to see you here in the wards. Are you out checking up on the local healthcare?
{playerName}: Just walking around and enjoying the city, before the election.

Staff: I know you are probably very busy, but do you have a couple minuts to help us. We are a bit short-handed in the children's section today. If you could read a short story for them it would help us alot? Will you do that for us?
{playerName}: Hello everyone, looks cozy in here
Staff: didn't expect you here {playerName}. What can we do for you
{playerName}: Just walking around the city and looking for people who needs some help
Staff: Actually, you can help serve lunch for the elderly. Don't know if you would like to help with that?
Principal: Hello there {playerName}, Sorry to bother you but we have a school meeting at the hall today and maybe you could participate
{playerName}: And what were you thinking should do
Principal: If you just had some inspirational words to motivate the young people, that will be all we need from you. What do you say?
